title: Unicorn wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 38,32 62,32' fill='#ff4fa3' />
  <polygon points='44,18 50,32 56,18' fill='#ffd93d' />
  <polygon points='47,13 50,8 53,13' fill='#5ce1e6' />
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='3' fill='#ffd93d' />
  <circle cx='42' cy='24' r='2' fill='#5ce1e6' />
  <circle cx='58' cy='24' r='2' fill='#5ce1e6' />

  <!-- Ears -->
  <polygon points='34,28 30,42 42,34' fill='#ffe66d' />
  <polygon points='66,28 70,42 58,34' fill='#ffe66d' />
  <polygon points='35,31 33,38 39,34' fill='#ffb3c6' />
  <polygon points='65,31 67,38 61,34' fill='#ffb3c6' />

  <!-- Horn -->
  <polygon points='50,24 45,44 55,44' fill='#ffe66d' />
  <line x1='48' y1='32' x2='52' y2='32' stroke='#ffb347' stroke-width='1.5' />
  <line x1='47' y1='38' x2='53' y2='38' stroke='#ffb347' stroke-width='1.5' />

  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#ffe66d' />
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#ffd93d' />

  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#ffb3c6' />
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='60' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#bf6b86' />
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='60' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#bf6b86' />

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='50' r='4' fill='#ffffff' />
  <circle cx='60' cy='50' r='4' fill='#ffffff' />
  <circle cx='41' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#3d1f6e' />
  <circle cx='59' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#3d1f6e' />
  <circle cx='42' cy='49' r='1' fill='#ffffff' />
  <circle cx='60' cy='49' r='1' fill='#ffffff' />

  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='57' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff7eb3' />
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='57' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff7eb3' />

  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M47 65 Q50 68 53 65' stroke='#bf6b86' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' />

  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='42' y='68' width='16' height='10' rx='4' fill='#ffe66d' />

  <!-- Mane -->
  <path d='M30 38 Q24 50 30 62 Q26 72 34 76' stroke='#ff4fa3' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' />
  <path d='M70 38 Q76 50 70 62 Q74 72 66 76' stroke='#5ce1e6' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' />
  <path d='M32 42 Q27 52 32 62' stroke='#ffd93d' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' />
  <path d='M68 42 Q73 52 68 62' stroke='#ff4fa3' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' />
</svg>
